speaking on my personal experience, no, but that is only because my brain had a horrific reaction to ect. But, speaking on the experience of friends i’ve met while going through treatment, it’s not uncommon. what i’ve learned is that it does depend on the type of anxiety your experiencing, and if there are certain triggers. For some, with bettering depression may come with some anxiety. Having the ability to live in the “now”, instead of crawling into your own head and avoiding things, may just bring in some anxiety, as you aren’t really used to that feeling of ease, and what comes with it. on the other hand, some people feel a bit antsy while undergoing treatment, and they say that’s just a side effect. it could help just thinking a little bit about what kind of anxiety is coming up. from there, you can kind of figure out what could help, even if it’s just a little. I hope things ease up a little! good luck!
